title.provenance: To enact R.S. 40:1615, relative to fire fighting foam; to provide for the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam containing fluorinated organic chemicals; ...

location.provenance: Be it enacted by the Legislature of Louisiana

pfas_definition.provenance: "PFAS chemicals" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom, including perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

type.provenance: B.  On and after January 1, 2022, no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals unless discharged under either of the following conditions:

date.provenance: On and after January 1, 2022, no person shall discharge or otherwise use...

who.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam...

action.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam...

products.provenance: "Class B fire fighting foam" means any foam designed to extinguish flammable liquid fires.

value: Discharge or use occurs in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation
Discharge or use is for training or testing purposes at a facility that has implemented containment, treatment, and disposal measures to prevent uncontrolled releases
exceptions.provenance:
(1)  Such discharge or other use occurs in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation.
(2)  Such discharge or other use is for training or testing purposes which occurs at a facility that has implemented containment, treatment, and disposal measures to prevent uncontrolled releases of such Class B fire fighting foam into the environment.

intentionally_added.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals
